summary: Join our Building Climate Resilient Communities Training Course to gain essential knowledge and tools for fostering sustainable, climate-adaptive communities.
lede: Climate resilience training helps professionals assess community climate risks and turn findings into practical plans. It is for people planning, funding, implementing, or evaluating community interventions across areas such as livelihoods, basic services, infrastructure, and preparedness. Participants practice assessing vulnerability and capacity, prioritizing actions by feasibility, impact, cost, and equity, and developing budgets and indicators to track resilience outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across various sectors who are involved in planning, implementing, and evaluating climate resilience interventions. You will benefit if you are responsible for designing, funding, justifying, or implementing community resilience actions.
audience: Urban planners, engineers, and built environment professionals
WASH, health, education, and agriculture professionals
Private sector CSR, sustainability, ESG, and risk
modules: Climate Risk and Community Resilience Fundamentals
Understanding Local Climate Hazards and Impacts
Resilient Basic Services: WASH, Health, Education
Disaster Risk Reduction and Early Warning at Community Level
Finance, Budgeting, and Value for Money in Resilience
Governance, Stakeholder Coordination, and Community Leadership
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning for Resilience Outcomes
Communicating Resilience Plans and Defending Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of climate change impacts and some experience in project management or community planning. Familiarity with local development issues is beneficial.
